title: Raid plan templates
intro: A template lays out the coarse plan without players: slots for tanks, healers and DPS, groups, raid marks, zones and task rows per boss. When an event's raid plan is made you pick one, and its slots are filled from the approved setup.
empty: Make a template, for example "Monday raid", lay out the slots, marks and zones per boss and apply it to an event later.
serverHint: With a server the template only shows for events on that server.
conflict: The template was changed in the meantime. Your changes are still here, but you can only save after reloading.
deleteText: Raid plans that already used it are left untouched, they have a copy of their own. The maps you uploaded for this template are deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
editorHint: There are no players here: slots (Tank 1, Healer 1 …) are filled from the event's setup when the template is applied.
noMatch: No template matches the search and filters.
besetzungHint: Set the size, tanks and healers, the rest is DPS. {groups} groups. The counts can be changed per boss in the editor.
dpsHint: What is left of the size after tanks and healers. The DPS slots are DPS 1..n, any damage dealer fits.
